There are several Twists that make TAR interesting:
- Express Pass: a pass that allows a team to skip any task.
- Yield: allows for one team to make another team wait at a clue box for 30 minutes, one use per team.
- U-Turn: allows for one team to make another team do both sides of a detour, most of the time this choice is made public, but sometimes it is a blind U-Turn board, one use per team.
- Double U-Turn: same thing as U-Turn, but allows for two selections, labeled as "2 U-Turn" in Logs.
- Save: a pass that allows a team to save themselves from elimination.
- Head-to-Head: a challenge before the Pit Stop that requires teams to face off against one another, with the winning team being able to check-in with Phil, if a team does not win at all on the Head-to-Head challenge, they are eliminated, often it functions like a Road Block where one team member competes at a time.
- Intersection: requires teams to choose a team to pair up with to compete together in challenges on a leg, normally for its entirety.
- Scramble: a series of three challenges where teams can pick any order to complete them in.
- Partner Swap: teams swap partners with another team till further notice.
- Driver's Seat: The first team to arrive at the challenge determines how hard the challenge is for all other teams.
